purpose: Reusable Tier-2 (Gemini Flash Lite) and Tier-1 (flagship) prompt set for the platform-dependency blog series and the Ghost Town Ep1 campaign. Every plate is composed to sit UNDER Photoshop-set display type: dark ground, deliberate negative space, zero baked-in text.

design_dna_ref.rule: single-glow — exactly one lime (#7CFC00) glow/rim-light source per frame; every other light stays neutral or warm-neutral; high contrast; restrained; no clutter

shared_composition_constraint: Composition constraint (mandatory, apply in every prompt): reserve at least one-third of the frame as deliberately empty, low-detail, near-black (#070907) ground with no subject, texture, or clutter in it — this negative space is reserved for large Photoshop display type added after generation, not for anything in the plate itself. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks, subtitles, captions, or UI copy anywhere in the image. Generated text is always illegible garbage; this plate must arrive completely clean so type can be set over it later in Photoshop.
shared_lighting_constraint: Lighting constraint (mandatory, apply in every prompt): follow the single-glow rule — exactly one restrained lime-green (#7CFC00) glow or rim-light source as the only saturated color accent in the frame; every other light source is neutral, cool-neutral, or warm-neutral against a near-black (#070907) ground. High contrast, editorial, restrained. No second or third colored light source, no rainbow gradient, no multiple competing highlights, no oversaturated fill light.
shared_negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, words, typography, captions, subtitles, logos, watermark, signature, UI chrome, readable screen content, readable signage, multiple light sources, colored gels other than lime, rainbow gradient, oversaturated colors, blown highlights, low contrast, flat lighting, muddy midtones, generic stock-photo smile, extra fingers, malformed hands, cloned faces, real brand name, real identifiable person, celebrity, logo mark, clutter, busy background, motion blur artifacts
